properties.description:
**BC000148 — Little Fort**

**Site Address**

235 WEBB RD, LITTLE FORT, BC, V0E2C0

**Site Info / Notes**

Schlage key

combo lock 2500

Schlage Key

Daylight access only

Delay call-out to daylight only HAS ADT SECURITY ON SITE.
YOU NEED A ASSIGNED CODE FOR SYSTEM ******Check Drive BC
for Little Fort ferry status! If Ferry not running must
drive from either Clearwater or Barriere. Follow Google
Maps along Dunn Lake Rd to Windpass Rd.

From Little Fort- Take Little Fort Ferry across Thompson
River (max. vehicle weight 9 metric tons). Proceed onto
Dunn Lake Rd. to top of hill (approx. 1 km)- take first
right, thru gate and uphill 2 km to where powerline goes
up to site - follow powerline to site.

There is a newer logging road near the powerline, make
sure you turn up (right) when you reach the line, do not
keep foloowing the logging road.

Alt Route From Clearwater: Turn onto Clearwater Village Rd
(Well's Grey Inn), follow road towards the ski hill across
the bridge onto Dunn Lake Rd. Follow signs for Apline
Meadows Resort, pass the resort and continue till you get
to a junction with road signs.

Turn right towards Little Fort Ferry onto Windpass Rd,
turn left through gate before going down the big hil to
the ferryl (should be able to see glimpses of the ferry
before the left turn) and follow above directions about
the power line to site. Worst case you end up at the ferry
and follow the above directions back up the hill and
continue to site.

Alt Route From Barriere: Turn off Hwy onto Berriere Town
Rd, turn onto Dunn Lake Rd and Follow to Windpass Rd (sign
for Little Fort Ferry turning left). Turn left through
gate before going down the big hil to the ferryl (should
be able to see glimpses of the ferry before the left turn)
and follow above directions about the power line to site.
Worst case you end up at the ferry and follow the above
directions back up the hill and continue to site.

Heavier loads must take the Dunn Lake road from Barrier -
approx. 40km from Barriere to site.

**GPS Coordinates**

* NOTE: 4X4 VEHICLE NECESSARY TO DRIVE THE LAST 3.2 KM OF
ROAD UP TO THE SITE. DO NOT ATTEMPT WITH 2-WHEEL DRIVE,
YOU WON'T MAKE IT.

FROM POWELL RIVER:

TAKE THE BLUBBER BAY FERRY TO TEXADA ISLAND. RESET
ODOMETER WHEN ON THE FERRY. ONCE ON TEXADA ISLAND, IT
TAKES ABOUT 1 HR TO GET TO THE SITE, ABOUT 25 KM DRIVE.

TRAVEL SOUTH 8.6 KM ON BLUBBER BAY ROAD TO GILLES BAY
ROAD.

TURN LEFT AT STOP SIGN (WHERE YOU SEE AN ESSO GAS STATION
ON THE RIGHT), INTO VANANDA.

FOLLOW ROAD DOWN AND TAKE THE RIGHT HAND BEND THROUGH
VANANDA. THE TEXADA ISLAND HOTEL IS THERE IN CASE YOU NEED
TO STAY.

TURN RIGHT AT COLUMBIA STREET. THERE IS A STORE THERE TO
GET FOOD, ETC. FOLLOW ROAD. NOTICE THAT THE ROAD NAME
CHANGES TO MIDAS AND THEN WALL ST.

CONTINUE ALONG THIS ROAD TO THE END OF THE PAVEMENT. YOU
HAVE NOW TRAVELLED 11.3 KM FROM THE FERRY TERMINAL.

CONTINUE ANOTHER 6.7 KMS ON GRAVEL ROAD UNTIL YOU REACH
18.0 KM.

TURN LEFT ONTO POCAHANTAS MAINLINE LOGGING ROAD (LOOK FOR
SIGN 'POCAHANTAS MAINLINE, ROAD FREQUENCY 154.460 MHZ,
TONE D023N'. AND ANOTHER YELLOW SIGN 'WATCH FOR LOGGING
TRUCKS, ACTIVE HAULING').

CONTINUE ALONG THE POCAHANTAS MAIN LOGGING ROAD FOR 4.5
KMS TO 22.5 KM. STAY TO THE RIGHT IF UNSURE WHICH WAY TO
GO (**DO NOT TURN RIGHT INTO BUSH AT 0.7 KM ALONG THE
POCAHANTAS MAIN LOGGING ROAD, THIS IS THE OLD ROUTE UP TO
THE SITE AND IS NOW OVERGROWN). STAY ON THE MAIN ROAD. AT
22.5 KM, LOOK FOR

Safety Issue

***Remote Site** emergency food on site may be expired,
come prepared and do not rely on food left on site,
GENERATOR ON EXERCISE CYCLE WILL RUN FOR 20 MIN EVERY
SECOND WEEK.,

**Site Address**

1150 HANNA CREEK RD, KOOTENAY BOUNDARY, BC, Canada

**Site Info / Notes**

Abloy 4.1=Shelter Door

Abloy 6.1=Lock box Key Key Card required for access to
Lockbox

Lock Box and Magnetic Key Gate Key in Trail CO. Bay 417
Lockbox.

NORMAL ACCESS ALERT!! 2017-09-19 There is now a locked
gate at the head of the road(1st left off Hanna Creek
Road). The key is held at BC2544 Trail CO (840 Spokane
St). Once at Trail CO go in side gate near top of parking
lot(4.1 Abloy to open gate). Go in 1st door just up
walkway after gate (Telus Card Reader Key required to open
Door). Once inside go up stairs on right 1 flight. Through
door on top of the stairs. Mobility equipment in 2nd row
counting right to left. Lockbox located in Bay 417 and 6.1
Abloy required to open. PLEASE LEAVE BUSINESS CARD OR NAME
AND PHONE NUMBER INSIDE BOX WHEN YOU TAKE THE KEY.

PLEASE RETURN KEY AS THIS IS THE ONLY COPY. IF LOST WE
WILL NOT BE ABLE TO ACCESS SITE.

the top of the hill from trail when you are midway past
the smelter, turn left on Warfield Hill Road. Follow the
road for 1KM then TURN RIGHT on Hanna Creek Rd. Drive for
1KM on the paved road then keep left at the Y in the road
onto the dirt road going up the hill. From the start of
the dirt road go 0.9KM then TURN LEFT up a kidney
pounding, hope I don’t get a flat road 2.1 KM to site. No
other roads or turns to make.

north side of the highway.

km, under the high voltage lines, take the severe right
turn. The site is at 1.8 km.

/ Oncall Tech immediattely to inform we are running on
backup generator.

alarm after approx 20 minutes. ,we are on Bateries with
approx 16 hours of battery Backup. contact Site Tech/ on
call Immediately as Simpson Maxwell will ned to be
dispatched Note!!! We (RFOPS now ) have IP access to both
Generator controller's See Site Pro for IP info.

we ge a low fuel alarm contact Doug Knight.

undriveable. ,

Whistler Creekside Cell Site From Hwy 99 heading north
towards Whistler, at Creekside Village turn left at Alta
Lake Rd. Continue to railroad tracks. Site is located on
the tower to the right. Access road .9 km from railroad
tracks.

Plowing

Coastal Mountain Excavations.

Safety Issue

Feb 15 2026 the erosion is now a 3ft hole ( Not Visible
untile you get stuck.) on the last left turn before site .
Do not Make the left turn or you will get stuck and need
to be towed out.

THIS ROAD NEEDS URGENT REPAIR OR BUILD A HELICOPTER PAD.

Message forwarded to BC Hydro 17-Dec-2025 - Do NOT use
access road to tower I was just up in Whistler at the
above noted site and noted there was some major water
damage on the access road to this tower.

Not only that, there was an active stream of water
dropping 3 plus feet under the middle of the road. I did
not realize the poor shape of the road until right up on
it. The road did partially give way in the middle just
down from where the water is running underneath. I would
put a notification that the road should be closed until is
able to be repaired. The more concerning part is the wire
gate at the bottom has had it’s lock cut and the cable is
laying on the ground and the road is open for public to
access. When the snow comes it may hide some of these
hazards from the public, especially the mountain bike
activity in the area.

I am not sure if the responsibility lies with BC Hydro to
correct or Telus as the road services both companies.

Please do not hesitate to call or email if you have any
questions or comments.

Mike Ramsay

Director – Treasurer

RKTG Associates Ltd.

**Site Address**

1075 HIKERS TRAIL RD, BOWEN ISLAND, BC, V0N1G0

**Site Info / Notes**

All door locks: BCA 3.1 Gate Key - ring 100 (Tested OK Nov
2010)

N/A

Ownership as follows:

BC0559 Bowen Island: Mobility has a License of Occupation
on Crown Land

SEPT 2012: ALL LOCKS HAVE BEEN CHANGED TO ABLOY BCA 3.1

****

Main access by Helicopter.

****

IMPORTANT - IF YOU HAVE TO HIKE TO THE SITE YOU MUST FIRST
OBTAIN SUPERVISOR APPROVAL!!!:

Key on Ring 100 @ 4519 Canada Way. A back up gate key may
be available at the Bowen Municipal Works Yard or RCMP or
Fire Dept. You can sign out a key from the Municipal Hall
604-947-4255 during regular business hours.

Take the Bowen Island ferry to Snug Cove. Continue up the
hill .8 km to the School. Turn right onto Mt. Gardener
Road. Continue for 3 km. Turn left onto Hiker's Trail
Road. At 3.4 km, there is a LOCKED GATE. RCMP have key
(the RCMP phone number is 947-0516 ). Go through the gate.

and continue up the road to 6.4 km. There is an old CBC
shack here - this is the start of the trail. The trail is
marked with signs and red markers on trees. Expect to hike
for about 50 minutes until you reach the site.

Elevation is approximately 2500 ft. If an accident occurs
call 911 give the location of the injured party and
emphasize you are on the Mt. Gardiner North Trail.
Response will be Bowen Fire Dept./Bowen Search & Rescue,
first. Backed up by North Shore Search & Rescue 24/7 by
water taxi, if necessary.

ADT Alarm Systems in Place Estimated Battery Life
(4/27/2018) -- 15.0 hours This site is fed by a private
powerline, and is the responsibility of SBA.

In the event of a suspected power outage send a email to:
Jezreel Gutierrez -- JeGutierrez@sbasite.com (also cc the
site tech) and inform him of the condition, he will
arrange for a crew to investigate and repair.

Safety Issue

**** See Special Info under the Access TAB when Suspected
Hydro outage

**Site Address**

4892 CELLULAR ST, SQUAMISH, BC

**Site Info / Notes**

Lockbox: Abloy 6.2

Shelter: Alboy 3.1

N/A

NORMAL Hwy. 99 north from Squamish/Brackendale.

Follow signs for Alice Lake Provincial Park.

-Turn right off Hwy. 99 at Alice Lake turn off.

Follow road in to park.

-At the brown and white "Alice Lake" sign, take the left
fork towards the campground.

-At the first BC Hydro pole on the right (transformer on
the ground and Hydro disconnect), stop and get the GREEN
key from the lockbox on the back of the pole.

-Continue to the campground, turn right in to the
campground off the main road. Proeed straight past the
gate house, and straight ahead towards the lake.

-Follow the road around the east side of the lake, through
the Beach Picnic Area.

At the end of the road is a yellow gate (in the
turn-around). Open the gate with the GREEN key from the
lockbox.

-Follow the 4x4 road to the top of De Becks Hill (about
2km).

If the road to the lake is gated off through the
campground, go back out to the main sign and try entering
through the day use area.

Alternate:

Heading Towards whistler from Squamish, take Lake Alice
exit off of HWY 99, First Right into Group Camp ground and
follow road through camps and parking lots until you reach
yellow gate, Combo 1400, lock gate after you, follow road
to site 4x4 low at some points.

Partitioned section of the building has the Squamish
emergency radio equipment in it.

The key hangs on the wall of the cell site jsut inside the
door.

N/A

NORMAL

Daylight access only

Daylight access only

NOV 2006: Wireline have placed another key for the Black
Tusk Radio Site in the Function Junction WIC. The WIC is
located on Alpha Lake road in Whistler. Turn Left off the
Sea to Sky Hwy onto Alpha Lake. WIC is on the right hand
side of the road just before the train tracks. You need a
Abloy 3.1 key to get into the WIC. Inside the WIC there is
a Lock BOX which requires a Older Telus 1096 Key.

Gate responsility Telus Radio The road is open mid-July to
October.

Aug 31 2020: After you get the key from the grey lock box
on the back wall inside of the WIC, cross over the highway
to the other side. You Should be on Cheakamus Lake Rd. Go
along that road for a few hundred meters. There will be a
road on your left. Take that road. If you take the correct
road you should see a 0 KM sign. Reset your trip meter to
0.Contiue on and you will come to a Y intersection. Take
the right road. A short distance down the road you should
come to a 1 LANE bridge over the river. Take that road. at
4.8 KM you should come to a another Y intersection with a
large gate on the right fork. That is your route.

You will now travel another 11.2 KM to get to the site for
a total of 16KMs to the upper tower and shelter.
Approximate drive time is 50 mins. Patrick.

Overnight Capable. IMPORTANT - KEEP GATE CLOSED AND LOCKED
EVEN WHEN AT THE SITE.

Note its recommended to replace lock with a COMBINATION
LOCK while accessing the Site. Label Combination Lock with
your Phone Number as other Cell Carriers and BC Hydro
access the Site. Please update Telus with Combination in
case of emergency.

Latitude: 49/59/7.5

Longitude: 123/03/25.4 Note!! Site is approx. 5600 ft
above Sea Level .

4x4 Access to Site is only from Late Augest to Mid
September due to extreme snow and steep road.

Be Extemely Carfull when driving to this site as its very
steep open shale road near the top. its recommended to
have 2 Vehicles travel to this Site at all times

Sept 2001: Milligan Creek Rd (PDR 200) is now radio
controlled. RX/TX frequency is 151.055 Use same safety
procedures as on the Fontas Rd.

MANDATORY ACCESS REQUIREMENTS: David Duke @ 250 261-8649
or marcel Johnson @ 250 261-8649 (see Contact list) LEAD

WCB regulations require you to use a VHF transceiver to
announce your positon (and monitor other traffic) on the
"Fontas Rd." The correct frequency is posted (by Canadian
Hunter Explorations Ltd.) at the start of the road. As of
2000 01, the frequency is 152.390 MHz. Be aware that
renegade truckers may not announce their position at all,
or may illegally use an inter-truck frequency "LAD 1"
154.100 MHz. Until the rules are more strictly enforced,
it may be prudent to monitor and/or announce on both
frequencies. When you transmit, identify yourself as an
"empty pickup" (if northbound) or as a "loaded pickup" (if
southbound). Example "Fontas 15, empty pickup". If you
dont have a VHF radio, you can probably rent one from
Quasar Communications in Ft. St. John. Phone ahead (250
785-6685) to reserve one.

The speed limit (as of 2000 01) on the Fontas Rd. is 80
km/hr. Canadian Hunter monitors the road with radar.
Repeat offenders may be banned from the road.

If you need meals and/or accommodations, try Velma City
Camp (25 km from Milligan site). Call 250 262-9937 well in
advance of your stay if possible. If Velma City Camp is
full, your choices are pretty much limited to sleeping on
the site floor, going on 80 km to Ring Reid Border Camp
(780 836-5760) or returning 148 km to Ft. St. John.

sign). At 110 km, reset your trip meter to zero, and turn
north onto Fontas Rd. At 38 km, turn west and again reset
your trip meter to zero. Travel west past 1.7 km (Velma
City Camp) and turn north at 1.9 km (Velma Compressor and
airstrip). Continue north past

At the stop sign turn right, this will get you back on to
Hwy 1 going eastbound.

back onto the highway.

Parking availible in front of gate as you pull off
highway.

the Eagleridge exit on the other side of the highway. You
need to take the exit so that you can get back going
eastbound on Hwy 1 to access site.

May 2020, The access into the main Telus room is done
directly from the P1 next to the East Elevator. Schlage
Lockbox next to the leasehold door.

If the gate is opened proceed with the vehicle, let the
security guard know where you're headed, turn left in P1
all the way to the end and then turn right all the way to
the end and park in the visitors spots by East elevators.

If the gate is closed call security desk at the number
posted and ask them to open the gate for you.

There is also a secondary room located in P2 just under
the main room but with access through the Rogers Room. You
need to sign out a key and elevator card from the security
desk.

Also the catwalk area could be accessed from the fifth
floor. Sign out a catwalk access card from the security
desk.Take the west elevator next to security and at the
fifth floor take a right and follow the corridor for about
100 feet. The catwalk access door is on the right, clearly
marked. Once you get through, follow the stairwell all the
way to the top area of the catwalk where our equipment is
located.

for concourse areas.

**BC001130 — Vancouver - Robson / Hornby (Robson**

**Site Address**

800 Robson, Vancouver, B.C.

**Site Info / Notes**

Contact security desk at 800 Hornby (door near giant red
screw sculpture) 24 hours.

See also access for BC851 Need bacground check (criminal
record)

.

24 Hr security guard See also BC851 located at the same
place and serving IDEN.

July 27 2016 New access contact: Alex Gordon

604.482.5600 -Security desk

604.377.2784 cell

agordon@paladinsecurity.com Site located in the basement
of the Court House at Robson with Hornby/Howe.

Use the access doors facing Robson and the red screw metal
sculpture.

At the security desk surrender your TELUS ID and ask for
the main telco room keys and somebody to escort you there
as it is under tight security.

Walk along the long corridor leading to the oposite side
of the building and take the elevator which is not
intended for public access.

Go one level down and then take a left. The security
escort will open the door for you. Walk straight for about
60 feet and the door will be on your left.

Area currently leased to UBC is known as 51 Block. Area to
south under Prov. Court is known as 61 Block. 'CB' key
opens hallway doors 'S' level of 51 block and doorway into
61 block. This is the route cables take. ResidentTELUS I&R
guys (Howard) usually sign out key rings 76 and 77. These
rings have 'CB' key and also key for main tel. room where
our repeaters are located. Ask security if one of these
ring are available. May also need mag. card for doors at
loading bay.

the stairs on your right to the Parking lot level. Take

**Site Info / Notes**

Door combo is 0652

ONSITE SECURITY

50 Pacific Blvd.

Enter through gate just a few meters west of our COW.

Combo 6521.

Read special info.

The Remote Guarding alarm for the site at 50 Pacific Blvd
is armed from 9:45pm until 6:4am every day and is meant to
keep the majority of the property secure. There are some
zones that the cameras don't reach due to the vegetation
in the park's gardens.

After hours Securitas guards may hear the alarm which is
when the remote guarding system is triggered by someone
entering the site. Radius will take care if it. They may
send out a Genesis Security mobile guard if the automatic
alarm doesn't make a trespasser leave the property
promptly. There is no need for the Securitas guards to
react to the alarm unless Radius contacts the on duty
guard or the on duty guard sees the individual that
triggered the alarm approach the Telus MEGA COW.

So again please have the on duty guards stay at the back
of the park by the Telus COW tower at all times and within
the red outlined zone so as to not set the alarm off after
hours.

I have marked on the Security Scope diagram where the
on-site porta potty washrooms are within the red outlined
zone. They are behind a gate with a combo lock with combo
6521. On duty guards can use them, but they must not move
into the fenced zone past the porta potty washrooms as
there is alarm in this area too. I have put up some
barriers so the guards will see where not to move passed
so as to not trigger this area's alarms.

Park staff will be onsite sometime around 6:45am every
morning and will enter through the gate off of Pacific
Blvd.

**Site Address**

**Site Info / Notes**

Compound gate: Schlage lock box key & or an abloy 1.1 key;
Site Door: Mag key: Puck

lock: Schlage lock box key

Padlock SEPT 15, 2011: There is a PUCK lock on the front
door of the building. This lock is keyed to the Schlage
lock box key.

Updated June 26 2015. They have opened up the South Fraser
Perimeter road to traffic now. Comming from the west on
River Road the road will take a 90 bend heading south
after the cement plant. You should see the tower and
compound on your right.

Just over the railroad tracks to the right is a steep drop
onto a short gravel driveway to our building. Take care as
there is not much of a shoulder to turn off the main
road!!!

If you are coming from the south end of Alex Fraser bridge
area head west on the Hwy 91 Connector for a few hundred
meters. Do not turn into the scales or go down Nordel Way
west of the bridge. If you drive by Tim Hortons you went
the wrong way. You will see a large intersection & you
will want to stay in the middle lanes that go through to
River Road. Go over the hill. This intersection has 3
options left to South Fraser perimeter road west bound
WRONG WAY. Right SFPR east WRONG WAY. Go over the hill.
You should see the tower on your left to the west. You
will have to go past the site & over the railroad tracks
and pull a U turn in the cement plants driveway. There is
a left turn lane to get into the cement plant. head south
again and hang a right just south of the railroad tracks.

Again watch out for traffic following to close because u
have to slow down to turn onto the grave driveway that
drops down!!

There is a new fixed DC generator on site now. June 2020.

- The portable generator has been removed.

There is still a platform for transporting gen sets but it
only works for the Suburbans. Not the F150's.- - - THE
MICROWAVE IS NO LONGER ACTIVE!!

NOTE: OCT 15 2021 I dont see the engine run alarm on the
WS1800.

Checking with Sim Max. Will send out tech to revisit alarm
issue. Patrick

The site was the old Biltmore hotel. The Beatles stayed
there in 1964. Now it is social

housing.

Access is via the door facing Kingsway. Ring the door bell
to get let in. Tell them you are with TELUS and someone
will take you up to

the rooftop or hand you the keys.

If you ask there is parking on past a secured gate. Steet
parking can be quite limited.

Get someone to leave you a radio or set of keys to get
back down to reception.

No Escort

24 Hr security guard

N/A

Safety Issue

Safety Issue: Night access is not recommened as The path
is rotten and it is damaged in many places, the holes
being covered with rubber mats. No repairs were done there
for years.

Drug addicts shooting themselves with evry possible
substance, even in front of the main entrance with no
regards of people coming or leaving.

Watch for used needles or seringes.

There is no limitation in those activities from the
building management prospective, more than that they seem
to encourage it by supplying free seringes and other
accessories. No law enforcement was noted.

If going there during night time it is advisable to have a
second person with you just to watch each other's back.

Make sure you carry with you a flash light after dark, to
be able to avoid tripping on the roof access path or to
step on the big water pools which are the norm. The path
is rotten and it is damaged in many places, the holes
being covered with rubber mats. No repairs were done there
for years.

Try to use the elevators by yourself or together with a
co-worker and avoid sharing it with the building
inhabitants, especially during Covid 19 crissis, if
possible.

street level emergency exit.

building roof towards South, about 100 feet, and reach the
antenna/radios steel structure.

Avoid going too much towards the roof edges because there
is no railing or parapet to stop you from falling.

most likely moisture due to the condensation given off
from the condenser unit that also causes the toxic
fume/condensation issues. We have fixed several other TX
line/jumper issues also due to the condensation in order
to get everything running properly. They typically turn
off the condenser unit in the fall as they no longer need
air conditioning for the building. This site should be
revisited once this unit is shut off in order to check all
antennas, lines and RET connections. The condensation
never stops as long as the condenser unit is on. We’ve cut
back 5 meters of AVA5 in Sector 3 and installed a longer
jumper as the line was full of water. Sector 1 & 3 are in
the same area as the condenser unit with Sector 3 being
beside the unit where the main exhaust pipe is. Sector 2
is nowhere near as bad as it is on the outside wall away
from the condenser.

**BC001757 — New Westminster - Salter St/Furness St**

**Site Address**

240 Salter, New Westminster, BC

**Site Info / Notes**

Keys and keyfob location - at BC0025 Queenborough Bridge
site under hydro tower.

Sign them out and in please.

Note: Keys and FOB should have an allen key

attached.

No Escort

NORMAL Park on street and use main entrance (key fob).

Note: Nov 25 2020. The FOB sensor is now on the left side
of the toutchpad.

Take elevator to 4th floor, turn right down the hallway,
use vertical ladder in the stairway to get to roof hatch.

Turn Allen key clockwise that is now on the key set from
BC0025 and then push hatch straight up. (Read Safety
Issue) - Outdoor cabinets are on the roof, All RRUs are
accessible.

New hatch setup completed in late 2019.

Safety Issue Update, June 2022. mechanical assistance rope
is broken and very unsafe to open hatch. Need to belt off
on the ladder to free up hands to open up hatch but the
hatch is very heavy and causes guillotine hazard.

Turn Allen key that is on the key set now clockwise and
push metal hatch straight up.

The hatch issue was addressed around November 2019.

IT appeares that you will still need an allen key to open
the lower hatch. Bring a set with you.

Once you open the hatch it should have some mechanical
help to lighten the load.

On the left side there is a gate lock that you can engage
to lock the hatch open.

There is also some kind of telescopic hand rail that can
be extended up to aid in geting onto the landing safely.
Press the lower relase latch and extend the bar up.

There is now a combo lock on the hatch. 4535 is the
combination. Apparently added July or Aug 2020.

Strata knows about the lock and combination now.

Note: Nov 25 2020. However the combo lock is on the hatch
that opens onto the roof. Bring a flashlight as the light
on the landing is not working well at this time.

There is a chain that can be put across the drop zone off
the second landing.

properties.description:
**BC002314 — Blackwater Mine (PWN)**

**Site Address**

8066 KLUSKUS FSR, BC, Canada

**Site Info / Notes**

N/A

SPECIAL

Power provided by mine For Camp access call Vanderhoof
office 2505673276

Camp Manager;

Yancy Baan(250)699-4003 From Intersection of HWY 16 and
Kenny Dam Rd in Vanderhoof, head SW on Kenny Dam Rd.

8k2 stay right.

16k1 road turns to Gravel.

26k1, Left on the Kluskus FSR.

Once you hit the FSR you will be at the 18.5km mile
marker.

Remain on this road until the 146 km marker where you turn
left and follow signage to the mine about 16km.

This is a radio controlled road:

Calling procedure is as follows on the way UP:

1.) At 18.5km you will turn your radio on to the Kluskus
channel(RR#21 151.01) and call "pickup on and up at
18.5km" this is actually the kilometer marker where you
gain access to the Kluskus(if you go thru Stoney Creek)
2.) At 92.5km switch to Plateau channel(RR#14 150.545) and
call up.

3.) At 146km turn Left onto mine road and change channel
to 173.670 and call up every km.

ON-Site, use 171.450 for First_aid and Camp Office.

NOTE: These roads are used by off highway logging truncks
and various other vehicles,all down traffic has the right
of way,the road has pullouts so use them to get out of the
way of all down traffic.

**On the way down you must call out every km on the New
Gold road and every odd km on the Kluskus.

**Useful Contact Info**

For Camp access call Vanderhoof office — 250-567-3276
Yancy Baan — 250-699-4003

Host end located in the wireline room on the first floor

to the very end where the the hallway T's. The wireline
door is on the left as you go down the hallway to the
right. Black lockbox on the wall with Abloy 6.2 key has
the door key in it.

Safety Issue This is a very large inbuilding site, that
requires a RAIC pass to access.

Every sector has a battery string to maintain power in the
event of a outage and the start up of the various on site
generators.

YVR quite regularly has scheduled power outages that
affect the AC supply to various sectors. The alarms
generated by this are more often than not due to the
sector battery string being recharged. If the sector has
not lost all power, wait until 0800 Pacific time at least
before generating a trouble ticket.

Please hold any S3 or lower tickets until working hours
and issue them to the local site tech to investigate.

Thanks , With the decreased volume in air travel due to
Covid, YVR has taken the opportunity to undergo several
very large renovations in the baggage area when we have
several antennas located.

The presence of scissor lifts and other steel equipment is
causing intermittent VSWR alarms to be generated.

Most of these alarms clear within a couple hours of first
being generated.

Please do not issue tickets for VSWR as they impossible to
investigate as the equipment has moved by the time the
tech is able to get to site to investigate.

Thanks,
